user.title: Set up Boopli
user.description: Boopli helps you break chores into small steps and nudges you through your phone, lights or speakers. If you choose a cloud AI service, the information you share goes to that service.

add_task.name: Add chore
add_task.description: Creates a one-time chore and starts it right away. The chore disappears when you finish it.

steps.name: Steps
steps.description: Optional steps. If you leave this blank, the chore has one step with the same title as the chore.

where.name: Where
where.description: Choose where you can do this chore.

start_chore.name: Start chore
start_chore.description: Starts a chore now, for example an on-demand chore like laundry.

chore.name: Chore
chore.description: The name or id of the chore.

complete_step.name: Complete step
complete_step.description: Marks the step that is waiting for you in a chore as done.

chore.name: Chore
chore.description: The name or id of the chore.

snooze_step.name: Snooze step
snooze_step.description: Delays the next nudge for the step that is waiting for you in a chore. The step stays open.

chore.name: Chore
chore.description: The name or id of the chore.

step_on_it.name: On it
step_on_it.description: Pauses nudges for the current step. Boopli can send a phone check-in after the configured delay, when nudges are allowed.

chore.name: Chore
chore.description: The name or id of the chore.

step_not_on_it.name: Resume nudges
step_not_on_it.description: Ends “On it” and resumes nudges for the current step.

chore.name: Chore
chore.description: The name or id of the chore.

delete_chore.name: Delete chore
delete_chore.description: Deletes a chore and stops any work in progress for it.

chore.name: Chore
chore.description: The name or id of the chore.

set_away.name: Set Away mode
set_away.description: Pauses scheduled chores and nudges. Chores marked "Keeps going while I'm away (for example pills)" keep going.

start.name: Starts
start.description: Local date and time Away mode starts, such as 2026-11-28 08:00. Leave blank to start now.

until.name: Until
until.description: Local date and time Away mode ends. Leave blank to end it yourself.

end_away.name: End Away mode
end_away.description: Ends Away mode. Paused chores resume nudges one at a time.
